project_name: LotNeeti - Smart IPO Planning & Cross-UPI Multi-Account Operations Tool
archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO (Tactical Fintech & Data Command)

rules: Never use pure #000000; use rich deep slate-indigo #090D16 for background
Reserve positive green (hsl(158, 85%, 42%)) strictly for gains, GMP, and active allotment success
Reserve warning amber/yellow for pending UPI mandates and limit threshold warnings
Never use gradient blanket overlays on hero images or main content surfaces
Ensure all card borders have subtle contrast (1px solid border-white/10)

hierarchy.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-white

layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: MODE B: High Density Grid (col-span-1 for stats, col-span-2 or 3 for primary tables and charts)
layout_and_spacing.header: Sticky glassmorphism header with z-50 backdrop-blur-md bg-slate-950/80 border-b border-white/10

key_features_to_implement.name: Auth Screen
key_features_to_implement.description: JWT Email & Password Login / Register tabbed view with stock market background aesthetic and pre-filled quick demo credentials button.

key_features_to_implement.name: Command Dashboard
key_features_to_implement.description: KPI cards showing Total Capital, Blocked Funds, Available Liquidity, Total UPI Mandate Limit (₹5L/UPI), Active IPOs count, and Quick Cross-UPI Auto Allocator launcher.

key_features_to_implement.name: Investor Profiles Hub
key_features_to_implement.description: Manage Family & Friends investors with PAN numbers, Demat type (CDSL/NSDL), 16-digit Demat Account number, default bidding category (Retail/sHNI/bHNI), and active application status.

key_features_to_implement.name: Banks & Cross-UPI Manager
key_features_to_implement.description: Bank account listing, available balance, linked UPI handles, active applications counter (max 5 apps per UPI handle rule), and per-UPI mandate total limit tracker (max ₹5,00,000 per UPI).

key_features_to_implement.name: IPO Directory Cards & Filter
key_features_to_implement.description: Live tabbed catalog of Open, Upcoming, and Closed IPOs featuring Issue Price, Price Band, Lot Size, Quota percentages, Live GMP (Grey Market Premium ₹ & %), Bidding dates, and Subscription Multiples.

key_features_to_implement.name: Smart Cross-UPI IPO Planner
key_features_to_implement.description: Pick open IPOs, choose target application count & category per investor, auto-calculate lot requirement, auto-assign bank balance & UPI handle according to rules, preview allocation table, and lock plan.

key_features_to_implement.name: Applications Tracker & Excel Export
key_features_to_implement.description: Comprehensive tracking table for all placed applications across investors and UPIs. Shows Mandate Status (Pending/Accepted), Allotment Status (Allotted/Not Allotted/Refund Initiated), and 'Export Excel for IPO Premium App' button.

key_features_to_implement.name: Funds & Mandates Monitor
key_features_to_implement.description: Visual breakdown of blocked money across banks, active UPI mandate health gauge, and fund release timeline.

testing_requirements.data_testid_rule: MUST add data-testid attribute on all buttons, links, inputs, tables, select dropdowns, modals, and metric elements.

universal_guidelines: Do not use transparent background on dropdowns, select options, popovers, or navigation bars.
Ensure numbers and monetary values use tabular digits (font-mono) and right alignment in tables.
Always display Indian currency formatting (₹, Lakhs, Crores) for readability.
Use Lucide icons for high quality, vector fidelity.
Use sonner for notifications and toasts.
All React code should be in .js files as configured in the project.
